claim: Volume is the sticky predictive half, so projections should universally lean on it.
replacement: Usage is observed opportunity; predictive value depends on target and comparison.

claim: A fixed RB age cliff represents universal biological decline.
disposition: Deleted flag, threshold configuration and fixed age multipliers
replacement: Measured age remains available; models must learn any relationship with outcomes.

claim: Historical scoring floor determines who starts and guarantees future exceedance.
replacement: Sample quantiles and volatility describe historical scoring, not validated lineup utility.

claim: NextGen identifies one model or a player-ability score.
disposition: Narrowed in research model labels and catalog organization
replacement: Distinct models have explicit targets, populations, horizons and evidence. No general ability estimator is established.

claim: RB residual correction establishes a selection improvement.
disposition: Excluded from recommended advancement; historical experiment retained
replacement: Recorded experiment has uncertain selection gain and worse point MAE; no broad replacement claim.

claim: More tree tuning establishes a broadly better QB model.
replacement: The recorded capacity search did not establish a broad improvement; scope-specific results remain available.

claim: Published approval is proof of intrinsic player quality or market advantage.
replacement: Approval is specific to an application target/horizon and evidence policy; ability and team context require separate definitions.

claim: Named-player overrides and fixed depth discounts establish forecast value.
disposition: Deleted override engine, player/team modifier files and depth multipliers
replacement: Observed team and depth information remain; archived override deltas are ignored by new rankings.

claim: Hand-built athletic and career interaction scores are necessary model inputs.
disposition: Deleted custom combine scores and legacy career-feature generation
replacement: Keep measured combine tests and experience. Saved raw RB model input contracts are preserved.
